details.title: A shock-tube study of NH3 and NH3/H2 oxidation using laser absorption of NH3 and H2O

property.name: evaluated standard deviation
property.method: combined from scatter and reported uncertainty

experiment.comment: The XML can be simulated without the measured pressure-time profile. It does not make significant difference in the simulation results but speeds up the simulation significantly.

The smoothed data series were obtained by selecting representative points from the original (raw) data series. The standard deviations of the smoothed data were obtained by linearly interpolating between the standard deviations of the two neighboring original (raw) data points.
All the specified uncertainties refer approximately to the 1sigma limits.

The NH3 uncertainties are 7% (average of the 6-8% interval, see Section "Uncertainty analysis") but not less than 15 ppm (signal noise, see Fig. 3.) or, if it is larger than 15 ppm, the absolute value of the minimal measured NH3 concentration in the data series if it was negative.

The H2O uncertainties are 5% (average of the 4-6% interval, see Section "Uncertainty analysis") but not less than 15 ppm (signal noise, see Fig. 3.) or, if it is larger than 15 ppm, the absolute value of the minimal measured H2O concentration in the data series if it was negative.
